title: PoppyTasks
description: The response to GET {tasks.endpoint}: the tasks a Company chose not to offer through the protocol, the skills it publishes, and its feedback endpoint, for one Session. Spec section 9, 9.1 (Excluded tasks), 9.3 (Feedback), and 9.4 (Agent context). The request carries the Session header and no access token. Unknown fields are allowed.
